actual_index_reduction: Label new elementary w/z local multiplicities n1,n2, and the two local neck-side multiplicities m1,m2 as in primary Figure5.3. On the local sphere mu(phi0)=n1+n2+m1+m2: it vanishes for a constant domain and each elementary bigon increases one corner multiplicity and index by one.

For a stretched limit write phiSigmaPrime for all old strips/old boundary or closed pieces not using alphas, and Aextra for alpha-plus boundary-degeneration pieces. Let nQ(Aextra) be multiplicity in an old alpha-region Q disjoint alphas. The Euler-measure/corner formula and neck matching give mu(phi)=mu(phiSigmaPrime)+n1+n2+m1(Aextra)+m2(Aextra)+2 sum_Q nQ(Aextra). The subtraction of m1+m2 from the sum of component indices is the finite matching correction; do not replace it by a tensor-product dimension assertion.

Every term is nonnegative for a regular positive limit. At index1 all disjoint-region Aextra terms vanish. Exactly one of five terms equals1: old strip index, n1,n2,m1(Aextra),m2(Aextra). Thus the only possible contributions are old D, the new w bigon, the new z bigon, and the two old-region alpha-plus boundary degenerations. This is a domain/index classification; its latter two counts still need the new normalization.

No limiting strip can have an endpoint at alphas intersect oldbeta, since no generator has such an assignment. A nonconstant strip component with an alphas boundary component having only the target puncture would have a projection to strip with a forbidden boundary extremum, or incompatible two-sided infinite limit. Reflection and the first nonzero term of a holomorphic function show that an upper-half-plane preserving boundary map has nonzero first derivative there. Hence extra alphas-bearing components are boundary degenerations, not hidden old flowlines.

The expected-dimensional obstruction excludes such limits. Moving roots far apart toward the beta edge reduces the parity to k multiplicity-one beta0 disk degenerations plus the constant strip. On a regular matched pair, retain the 2k root-position modes and invert the evaluation difference on their transverse finite block. The other normal operator on each punctured piece has the cylindrical Cauchy-Riemann inverse with the zero constant neck modes removed; Fourier modes on each normal circle have nonzero gap. Patch with long cutoffs, correct the O(1/T)+exponentially small error by a Neumann series, and solve the quadratic remainder on the normal slice. Compactness plus the five-case index classification puts any convergent sequence in one of these same contraction charts. A fully instantiated proof still needs the alpha-plus degeneration regular/count operation in the other two cases.
